title: SkillQualityReviewResult
description: Structured output contract for evaluating-skill-quality's Procedure step 6 verdict, from this repository's own design record (see this skill's tracking issue). Consumed by a companion schema-conformance checker script, never by the PR-body disclosure gate (gitapex_gate_skill_audit_disclosure.py), which keeps checking its own free-text WELL-FORMED-AND-MATURE-style tokens unmodified.

reviewMeta.description: Mirrors evaluating-deterministic-gate-quality's own reviewMeta required/optional split (output-schema.json: actor/targetRepoRef/skillBuildRef required, artifactRef and dispatchIsolation optional) for one family vocabulary across both skill-quality-review schemas.

actor.description: Unlike the precedent (whose actor object states 'Required detail when provenance=verified' in prose only, with no schema if/then enforcing it), this schema mechanically enforces it below: a record claiming a verified identity must carry non-empty supporting verification data, not merely assert the label.

artifactRef.description: The reviewed skill's directory, e.g. skills/duplicate-ticket-detector. Optional -- omitted only when targetRepoRef alone already identifies the one artifact under review.

skillBuildRef.description: Commit or ref of SKILL.md/references/* that produced this verdict.

shapeCheck.description: Procedure step 3's deterministic result -- reported structurally so a consumer can assert PASS/FAIL per named check instead of grepping prose.

checkerRef.description: e.g. scripts/gitapex_check_skill_shape.py, or 'manual' when Python is unavailable.

cohesion.description: rubric.md's own seven-type taxonomy, cited verbatim.

stepLevelFindings.description: check is a free-form string, not a closed enum: the named step-level Mechanism-fit checks have grown by name more than once already (e.g. Subagent delegation scope, Invocation-mode fit) and a closed enum would need a schema bump on every future addition.

compatibilityAwareness.description: Warning-only, never participates in the verdict (rubric.md's Verdicts section).

dimensions.description: One entry per rubric.md dimension 1-9, in any order. The allOf below requires each dimensionId in {1..9} to appear at least once across exactly 9 entries -- by pigeonhole, that forces each to appear exactly once, so no separate uniqueItems-style rule is needed.

items.description: evidence is always present but its minItems requirement is conditional (see this item's own allOf): non-empty for every ordinary verdict, so SCHEMA_CONFIRMED cannot validate a keyword-stuffed entry with no citations (rubric.md's Procedure step 5: 'No cited evidence means no review happened'); allowed empty only for the one legitimate case (a genuinely 'unmeasured' dimension 8 or 9, which this same allOf also confines dimensionId to).

verdict.description: 'unmeasured' is legal only for dimensionId 8 or 9 (rubric.md's Verdicts section: dimensions 8-9 are the one exception where a named-but-unmeasured gap does not block Mature).

token.description: ALL-CAPS-WITH-HYPHENS, matching gitapex_gate_skill_audit_disclosure.py's own _VERDICTS vocabulary casing for the first three values. INDETERMINATE is this schema's own fourth state; the disclosure gate itself has no INDETERMINATE token and instead routes that case through its WAIVED-plus-reason escape hatch (rubric.md's Verdicts section).

reason.description: Required when token is NOT-WELL-FORMED or INDETERMINATE, per rubric.md's own Verdicts section ('State the specific failing check(s)' / 'State the concrete blocking cause').

supersedes.description: Optional. When this record corrects an earlier one, a reference to the record it replaces -- reusing eval-run.schema.json's own 'a correction is a new record naming its predecessor, never an edit to it' convention.
